svg.title: /research command — example output mock-up
svg.desc: Mock-up of what /research returns: a structured Claude Code response with a section header, three bullet groups for findings/patterns/contradictions, and inline citations linking back to the user's NotebookLM sources. Shows the value of going from raw MCP to an opinionated workflow.
svg.text: ✓ Phase 1 — collected 5 sources, auto-expanded with 3 more (8 total)
based on 8 NotebookLM sources · structured analysis
• Claude Code adoption tripled after Opus 4.6 1M context release [1, 4]
• Subagent + hook pattern is the de-facto standard for regression prevention [2, 5, 7]
• MCP servers shipped: Playwright, GitHub, Postgres, Context7 lead by usage [3, 6]
• Three of four sources frame the bottleneck as discipline, not memory [1, 2, 5]
• Conversation indexing emerges as a parallel solution to context drift [2, 7]
• Source [3] claims 10× token savings; sources [1, 5] caution that the real win is
• Adopt CLAUDE.md + subagents for any team using Claude Code in production [2, 4, 6]
• Pair with hierarchical context (Level 0 / Level 1) for multi-project setups [7]
▸ Generate artifacts? (1) Audio overview · (2) Mind map · (3) Flashcards · (4) Briefing doc
— citations [1]–[8] map to your 8 NotebookLM sources, click in NotebookLM for the exact passage
